scope: Historical Eagle Farm compound around 1838, with the stockade, timber-slab female barracks, six-cell block, working buildings and superintendent’s and matron’s quarters.

originalReview.notes: The original CC0 site photograph shows the modern grassed archaeological site and trail. It is only a location and ground-context reference. The modern interpretive artwork is excluded from the model.

quallaSearch.notes: Qualla first. The exact CC0 Shiftchange photograph identifies the current park and trail only. The Qualla hero is the 1837 plan of the earlier Brisbane Town Female Factory on Queen Street, explicitly a different site, and is excluded. The archive’s online reproduction of the relevant design sheet carries a conflicting reserved-rights label and was not used. Original geometry derives from the written 1837 correspondence, the 1839 inventory reported in the archaeologists’ study, and current survey context.

excludedHistoricalImagery.reason: 1837 Brisbane Town Female Factory plan concerns the earlier Queen Street institution, not this prison.
